extra_lines: Only Cassie grows. Nadia stays a fixed size-3 build the entire book — she NEVER grows and NEVER shrinks; she is the constant ruler (L37 scale-constancy).
Cassie reads obviously TINY at size 1 (swamped in oversized clothing) so the later size-flip lands. The early small-vs-big gap with Nadia is the whole gag.
On contrast panels (P9, P11, P13, P14, P15) Nadia is a normal-sized adult correctly scaled to room anchors (table, bar, doorway) — she is tiny ONLY by comparison to giant Cassie, she has NOT shrunk.
Both characters are adults aged 25 (rule_comic_adult_only) — never depict a teen or minor.
Vary body orientation across the run (L37): no more than ~2 consecutive front-facing panels; include 3q-rear/back (P3, P6, P7) and profile/over-shoulder beats.
